object.name: evi_cfsmooth
object.digest: Linear signal smoother particularly well suited to smoothing filter cutoff frequencies
object.description: Based on Andy Simper's smoother, evi_cfsmooth tracks the input value via the bandpass output of an SVF filter and logarithmically updates. Smoothing is specified in both ramp time (ms) and filter cutoff (Hz). <o>evi_cfsmooth</o> is available in MSP as <o>evi.cfsmooth~</o>.

inlets.name: ramp
inlets.digest: Amount of time the value takes to reach it's destination. evi_cfsmooth is logarithmic and does not reach it's destination exactly.

outlets.name: output
outlets.digest: Smoothed output ramp, or target value if ramp is complete.

attributes.name: hz
attributes.description: evi_cfsmooth is a two-pole filter. The Hz value sets the filter cutoff. This is typically between 1..10 Hz. The lower this value, the more agressively the curve shape is flattened out.
